description: Jobs open at a company now, from its public board on Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, SmartRecruiters, Recruitee, BambooHR, Personio, Teamtailor, Rippling, Gem, Breezy or Pinpoint. Give a company name, website or board URL; the board is found from the name, our daily crawl of 18,000+ boards, or links on the company's own site. Filter by title, location or remote. Returns the newest 50 matching jobs (title, location, remote flag, salary when shown, apply link). Costs $0.005 USDC on Base via x402.

company.description: Company name (stripe), website (stripe.com) or job-board URL (https://jobs.lever.co/palantir)

location.description: Keep jobs whose location, country or workplace type contains this text (london, remote)

remote.description: true keeps only jobs marked remote

title.description: Keep jobs whose title contains this text; comma-separate alternatives (engineer,developer)

name: company_jobs
